## Checks

- [ ] `npm run validate` has no findings
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or generated output

## If this changes a skill

- [ ] The change to its instructions comes with evidence (old and new wording on the same task), recorded in that skill's `learning.md`. Not needed for a typo or a broken link.
- [ ] A skill that runs shell commands or touches the network has had an independent security review, and the result is recorded.
- [ ] I did not weaken a test, a check or a protected-path rule to make something pass.
